overview: This single-page list of papers is an index entry for State Department file 894A.911 on newspapers in Formosa (Taiwan). It records one item, a Taihoku Report associated with Money and dated September 14, 1936, described as a news survey concerning Taihoku, Taiwan, in the Japan consular district. The sheet does not contain the report itself but directs the researcher to decimal-file reference 800.911/33a 925.

people.name: Money
people.role: Person associated with or author of Taihoku Report J-; precise role not stated

subfiles.title: List of Papers for Newspapers—Formosa, Taiwan
subfiles.about: An index sheet records and cross-references a 1936 news survey concerning Taihoku, Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists one document under the subject “Newspapers - Formosa, Taiwan.” The entry identifies it as Taihoku Report J-, associates it with Money, and dates it September 14, 1936. It describes a news survey relating to Taihoku, Taiwan, in the Japan consular district and directs readers to file reference 800.911/33a 925; the underlying report is not included here.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as a provenance and cross-reference record rather than as substantive reporting. It documents the existence, date, and filing location of a Taihoku news survey that is absent from this bundle, illustrating how State Department material on colonial Taiwan could be distributed across different decimal-file classifications. It may help historians trace press monitoring and consular information-gathering in Japanese-ruled Taiwan.
